description: Generate login link. If a valid link with the same settings exists, it will be returned instead of creating a new one.

exam.description: the exam identification string to redirect the user to (mutually exclusive with redirect)

expires.description: expiry in days (1-30) or YYYY-MM-DD (default: 1 day)

logins.description: total count the link can be used to login users (default: 1)

redirect.description: redirect after a successful login (URI path or [{content_type}:{tag}])

short.description: generate shortened (eduba.se) link (only if feature is enabled on EduBase) (default: false)

template.description: a template ID for the login link

name: edubase_post_user_login
